events.title: Bokcuks' Steam Page Is Live! 🎉
events.summary: Hello, everyone!My main goal with Bokcuks is to create a survival game that contains no text at all. That way, anyone from anywhere in the world will be able to play Bokcuks with ease. At least, that’s what I’ll be working toward.I’m also aiming for a fun art style to achieve a pleasant and simple visual aesthetic.
